title: A Companion's Simple Question
paragraphs: A companion once asked the Prophet ﷺ for a short piece of advice that he could remember and apply easily in his daily life, since he worried he might forget something too long or complicated.
The Prophet ﷺ replied simply: do not become angry. The companion asked again a few times, hoping for something different, but received the exact same short answer each time.

Later, reflecting on this exchange, many scholars note that the simplicity of the advice does not mean it is easy to follow, since managing one's own anger consistently takes real practice over an entire lifetime.
Many people today share this story when discussing anger management at work or at home. A short piece of advice, repeated with patience, can sometimes carry more weight than an entire lecture.
